page.title: Your groceries
page.purpose: Answer what to buy and what has been picked up: a stable list derived from the plan, reviewed for pantry checks and quantities, then shopped with large checkboxes — without ever confusing a checkmark with a purchase.

priorities.statement: The list's scope — which plan, dates, and meals — is stated before any item.
Review surfaces pantry checks, quantities, and contributing meals; Shop surfaces large checkboxes and amounts; both exist on every device and the chosen mode is remembered.
Checking a row means picked up and nothing more; purchases reach the pantry only through Confirm purchases.
Plan changes arrive as a reviewable diff that keeps picked-up items, manual items, and overrides.
Unknown prices and quantities stay visible; no estimated total appears without price coverage.
Shopping keeps working offline and shows which changes are waiting to sync.

states.description: Review mode for this week's list, grouped by aisle, with the planning sidebar on wide screens.
First read of the page's data; stable skeletons reserve the layout so nothing shifts on arrival, and no sample food is shown as saved data.
Some contributing data is unknown or could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown next to it.
A write is in flight; the affected control shows a busy state and says why it is unavailable, and success appears only after the durable save.
Locally queued changes are replaying; each pending item is marked until the server confirms it.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated, pending edits are kept, and nothing is edited against a fake empty account.
Input was rejected; the offending field is identified next to it and every other edit is preserved.
The API is unreachable; the loaded list stays usable, checks and manual items are queued locally, and each pending change is marked.
No plan feeds a list yet; Plan my week and Add item are offered.
Shop mode: large checkboxes, amounts, progress, and a collapsed Picked up group.
A row was just checked; it moves to Picked up with an immediate Undo and focus stays in the list.
The plan changed while shopping; a diff lists Added, Changed, and No longer needed, keeping picked-up and manual items.
Have this is recording a stock assertion with a quantity or qualitative amount; the row is not checked.
Confirm purchases previews actual amounts and optional prices before creating purchase and stock events once.
One of two needed packs was bought; the remaining need stays visible.
No price observations exist; the sidebar says Add prices to estimate your total and no total is shown.
An offline change conflicts with a newer server change; both are shown with a resolution and nothing is lost.

claims.statement: The list's scope is read before the first aisle group.
Review and Shop are both available on phones and desktops.
Checking a row records picked up only; it creates no payment, pantry, or intake event.
Have this records a stock assertion and leaves the row unchecked.
A checked row moves to Picked up with an immediate Undo and no loss of focus.
A plan change arrives as a diff and keeps picked-up items, manual items, and quantity overrides.
Confirm purchases previews amounts before recording them exactly once.
A partial purchase keeps the remaining need visible.
Without price coverage the page says Add prices to estimate your total instead of showing a total.
Offline checks and manual items are marked pending until the server confirms them.
A replay conflict is shown with both versions and a resolution; no edit is lost.
Shop-mode checkboxes and row targets are at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels.
The mode switch, rows, Have this, Undo, Add item, and Confirm purchases are keyboard reachable.
Amounts stay aligned and the page never scrolls sideways.
Light and Evening change palette and artwork only; the recipe, servings, dates, occurrences, layout, and actions are identical.
